iut_type: End Products (Paramount Bed, 6 additional products sharing the same Bluetooth module), bulk derivative model registration
customer_question: In addition to our main registration, we'd like to register 6 more products using the same Bluetooth module — can you give us a quote for this bulk derivative registration?
question_variants: How is a bulk addition of several derivative models handled administratively?
Does adding multiple derivative models at once require a quote or incur cost?
actual_issue: The customer wanted to add a substantial batch of 6 additional derivative-model products sharing the same Bluetooth module to their existing registration, and asked for a cost quote for this bulk addition, unsure of the process or whether it would be a paid service.
plain_english_explanation: For a bulk batch of derivative models sharing the same Bluetooth module, Allion can use an Excel-based Product Import Template to streamline the addition process — the customer simply fills in the additional product rows in the provided spreadsheet (replacing or removing the sample row included as a formatting example), and Allion processes this batch addition free of charge, since it falls under the standard free derivative-model registration mechanism rather than requiring a new paid registration.
consultant_answer: Please fill in the additional product rows in the attached Excel Product Import Template (the third row is just a formatting sample — overwrite or delete it and list only your actual additional models starting from that row). We'll process this batch addition free of charge, since it falls under the standard free derivative-model registration mechanism.
decision_logic: Bulk derivative-model additions sharing an existing registration's Bluetooth module/stack are processed via an Excel-based import template for efficiency at scale, and remain free of charge under the same policy that applies to single derivative-model additions, regardless of how many products are added in one batch.
final_recommendation: When a customer requests a bulk addition of multiple derivative models at once, offer the Excel-based Product Import Template as an efficient batch-processing method, and confirm upfront that the addition remains free under the standard derivative-model policy regardless of batch size.
risk_if_done_wrong: A customer might assume a bulk addition of many products simultaneously would incur cost (since it's a larger request than a single addition), leading them to either delay the request or underestimate how straightforward bulk batch processing actually is.
